fusions.name: Lit Fuse
fusions.desc: Lashes a burning fuse at an enemy up to 6 tiles away for 10 damage, up to 1.3 times as much at full reach, and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Down to the Wick
fusions.desc: Burns every affliction you have on the target down at once: consumes them all to deal 16 damage, 60% more for each one consumed, and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Cautery Gauze
fusions.desc: Presses smouldering gauze to your wounds. It restores 16 health to you, and its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Slow Match
fusions.desc: Conjures a burning cord to fight with: your weapon damage rises by 12%, and every strike leaves the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
